definitions.gloss: part of speech; word class; grammatical category
definitions.explanation: A grammatical classification of words based on their function in a sentence, such as noun, verb, adjective, adverb, and so on. A fundamental concept in Japanese grammar study.

examples.english: What part of speech is this word?

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本語|にほんご}→日本語：00614_nihongo⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{多|おお}く⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{品詞|ひんし}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧。
examples.english: Japanese has many parts of speech.

examples.japanese: ⟦{辞書|じしょ}→辞書：04707_jisho⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦{単語|たんご}→単語：03413_tango⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧とき、{品詞|ひんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{確認|かくにん}する→確認する：25332_kakuninsuru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{使|つか}い{方|かた}→使い方：07797_tsukaikata⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦わかりやすい→わかりやすい：09582_wakariyasui⟧。
examples.english: When looking up a word in the dictionary, checking its part of speech makes it easier to understand how to use it.

notes:
USAGE:
A grammar term used in language study and linguistics. Japanese traditional grammar recognizes categories such as ⟦{名詞|めいし}→名詞：10420_meishi⟧ (noun), ⟦{動詞|どうし}→動詞：03472_doushi⟧ (verb), ⟦{形容詞|けいようし}→形容詞：10419_keiyoushi⟧ (adjective), ⟦{副詞|ふくし}→副詞：00441_fukushi⟧ (adverb), ⟦{助詞|じょし}→助詞：03351_joshi⟧ (particle), and ⟦{助動詞|じょどうし}→助動詞：12373_jodoushi⟧ (auxiliary verb), among others.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {品詞|ひんし}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{調|しら}べる→調べる：01213_shiraberu⟧ (to look up the part of speech)
- {品詞|ひんし}⟦{分類|ぶんるい}→分類：04790_bunrui⟧ (classification by part of speech)
- {品詞|ひんし}⟦{分解|ぶんかい}→分解：08389_bunkai⟧ (parsing into parts of speech)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{文法|ぶんぽう}→文法：01506_bunpou⟧: grammar — the broader system of language rules
- {語類|ごるい}: word class — a more academic synonym
